label: eleven-us-male-1
_help: ElevenLabs dashboard: Voices > Voice Library, filter Gender=Male, Accent=American, Use case=Narration. Add a voice to My Voices, then copy its Voice ID (voice menu > Copy voice ID). Stock/library voices only, no cloning. Check the voice's licence allows commercial use. Optional field modelVersion overrides the default model id.

label: chirp-us-male-1
_help: Google Cloud console: Text-to-Speech > Voices (or the Cloud TTS voice list docs). Filter language en-US, family Chirp3-HD, a male voice. The voiceId is the full voice name, shaped like en-US-Chirp3-HD-<Name> (copy it exactly from the list). The API key goes in GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY (restrict it to the Text-to-Speech API).

label: cartesia-us-male-1
_help: Cartesia playground (play.cartesia.ai): Voices library, filter English and a male voice with an American accent, pick a stock voice (not a clone), then copy its voice ID (a UUID). Optional field modelVersion overrides the default model id.
